# fct_surveys_time_tracking

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_surveys_time_tracking` · dbt area: `surveys`

Advisor responses to the Time Tracking survey from Typeform, sent in Q1 2025. Captures hours spent per week across advisor work categories plus other commitments outside advising. Each row is one response from an advisor. Sourced from Intercom and Typeform.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `response_id` | The Response ID from Typeform >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_uuid` | The Advisor UUID reference to the Portal database >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `anything_else_to_share` | Free text response to 'Is there anything else you’d like to share about how you manage your time or improve your productivity?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `form_id` | The Typeform Form ID >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `has_other_commitment_another_job` | True if they select another job / running a business from 'In addition to advising, how else do you spend your time?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `has_other_commitment_any` | True if they select any results from 'In addition to advising, how else do you spend your time?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `has_other_commitment_caregiver` | True if they select caregiver from 'In addition to advising, how else do you spend your time?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `has_other_commitment_hobbies` | True if they select hobbies / personal projects from 'In addition to advising, how else do you spend your time?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `has_other_commitment_other` | True if they selet 'Other' from 'In addition to advising, how else do you spend your time?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `has_other_commitment_student` | True if they select pursuing education / training from 'In addition to advising, how else do you spend your time?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `has_other_commitment_volunteer` | True if they select volunteering from 'In addition to advising, how else do you spend your time?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `hours_per_week_administrative_tasks` | Numeric answer to 'How many hours is spent on administrative tasks?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `hours_per_week_destination_research` | Numeric answer to 'How many hours do you spend researching destinations?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `hours_per_week_existing_client_communication` | Numeric answer to 'In a typical week, how many hours do you spend communicating with existing clients?'  >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `hours_per_week_itinerary_building` | Numeric answer to 'How many hours do you spend building and formatting itineraries?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `hours_per_week_new_client_acquisition` | Numeric answer to 'How many hours of your week is dedicated to marketing or new client acquisition?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `hours_per_week_rate_quoting_and_booking_management` | Numeric answer to 'How many hours do you spend quoting rates and managing bookings?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `hours_per_week_supplier_relations` | Numeric answer to 'How many hours do you dedicate to supplier relations?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `hours_per_week_total` | Numeric answer to 'Think about a typical week throughout the year (not the peak, not the quietest). How many hours do you dedicate to working in your role as a travel advisor?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `is_latest_submission` | Whether the response was the latest (most recent timestamp) of all that advisors's submissions >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `is_willing_to_interview` | Yes / no response to 'Would you be interested in participating in a 1:1 interview to share more insights about how you spend your time as a travel advisor?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `monthly_clients_count` | Numeric answer to 'How many clients do you actively manage in a typical month?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `most_frustrating_tasks` | Free text answer to 'Are there any tasks that feel disproportionately frustrating compared to the time they take?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `non_advising_time_commitment_list` | Multiple choice selection for 'In addition to advising, how else do you spend your time?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `ranking_tasks_most_to_least_difficult_list` | List of the ranking answer to 'Rank these tasks from most difficult (1) to least difficult (7).' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `self_identify_as_full_or_part_time` | Single choice from question 'Do you consider yourself a part-time or full-time advisor?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `submitted_at` | When the Advisor submitted their survey response. >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `tasks_with_most_opportunity` | Free text answer to 'Which tasks do you feel could benefit the most from automation or workflow improvements?' >> SOURCE - Typeform |
